cues.text: You and Akihiko meet in the dorm's kitchen. Akihiko has brought a plastic shopping bag of groceries.
Akihiko cracks eggs and mixes the batter while you cook the pancakes in a pan. Before long, plates piled with pancakes cover the counter.
Yukari and Fuuka walk over to the kitchen.
Later, everyone gathers at the dining table around the pancakes: Yukari, Junpei, Mitsuru, Fuuka, Ken, Aigis and Koromaru, with you and Akihiko.
Everyone eats together. When the plates are empty, Ken comes over to you and Akihiko.
Akihiko breaks off and winces in pain.
